qaMethod: Native-detail visual inspection of every accepted candidate against the sole canonical original, plus read-only SHA-256, PNG dimensions, RGB<245 edge-margin, subject-fill, aspect-ratio, unique-hash and generator-source byte-equality checks. No image was altered during QA.

acceptanceRules.signatureGeometryPreserved: complete very tall and narrow straight-on assembly; two slim square-profile full-height outer posts; straight layered horizontal top header; very dark full-height recessed reveal immediately inside the left post; asymmetric leaf and stile placement with a broad right vertical field; exactly one tall central inset rectangular panel; one outer stepped double raised rectangular molding with four right-angle corners; exactly one thin warm gold/brass complete rectangular inlay; one uninterrupted flat central field; broad bottom rail; vertical grain on panel and stiles with horizontal grain on rails and header
acceptanceRules.hardwarePreserved: exactly one short slim dark antique-style horizontal lever pointing right from one circular rosette around 58% height, exactly one separate small circular dark key escutcheon below, no visible hinges and no additional hardware

minimalWhiteMargin.goal: make the complete door occupy the canvas as fully as possible
minimalWhiteMargin.sourceEdgeContactException: Negro, wengue, gris-oscuro, antracita, roble and natural contact the bottom exactly as the canonical source does. Nogal contacts top and bottom; its top contact differs by only two pixels from the canonical source. Native-detail inspection confirms the complete top header, posts, lower endpoints, moldings and full silhouette in every accepted contact case.
minimalWhiteMargin.lightFinishMeasurementNote: Gris-claro and blanco retain complete visible contours; RGB<245 is conservative because pale finish pixels near the outer frame approach the pure-white background.

summary.visualInspection: PASS: all accepted finishes preserve the complete two-post frame, layered header, dark full-height left reveal, one tall double-molded panel, one complete gold/brass rectangular inlay, one lever on one circular rosette, one separate cylinder, no visible hinges and no logo or text.
